description: This file defines the LeaveLeaveEntitlement entity class, representing a leave entitlement association in the OrangeHRM system. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes properties such as id, leave, entitlement, and lengthDays, along with corresponding getters and setters.

classes.name: LeaveLeaveEntitlement
classes.description: Entity class mapped to ohrm_leave_leave_entitlement table, representing leave entitlement records linking leave and entitlement entities with an associated length of days.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the leave entitlement record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the leave entitlement record.

methods.name: getLeave
methods.description: Returns the Leave entity associated with this entitlement.

methods.name: setLeave
methods.description: Associates a Leave entity with this entitlement.

methods.name: getEntitlement
methods.description: Returns the LeaveEntitlement entity linked to this record.

methods.name: setEntitlement
methods.description: Associates a LeaveEntitlement entity with this record.

methods.name: getLengthDays
methods.description: Retrieves the number of days for this leave entitlement.

methods.name: setLengthDays
methods.description: Sets the number of days for the leave entitlement.
